schema_sql: CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS Communication (id INT IDENTITY PRIMARY KEY, comm_action NVARCHAR(255), comm_channelid INT, payload NVARCHAR(MAX))
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_comm_action ON Communication(comm_action)
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_comm_channelid ON Communication(comm_channelid)
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_payload ON Communication(payload)
generation_sql: INSERT INTO Communication (comm_action, comm_channelid, payload) SELECT CONCAT('Action_', n), n % 10, CONCAT('Payload_', n) FROM (SELECT TOP {row_count} ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY (SELECT NULL)) AS n FROM sys.objects) AS numbers

tables.name: Communication
tables.purpose: Primary table to reproduce blocking and index-related performance issues.
tables.distribution_notes: Simulates a large OLTP table with excessive indexes and varied data distribution.
